evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we present the first dataset, MailEx, for performing event extraction from conversational email threads.

To understand the task challenges, we conducted a series of experiments comparing three types of approaches, i.e., fine-tuned sequence labeling, fine-tuned generative extraction, and few-shot in-context learning.
